::: {#def-network-weights-vector .theorem}
## Network weights

The vector of the edge weights node $i$ shares with the other nodes of [graph](#def-graph) $\mathscr{G} = (\mathcal{N}, \psi)$.

$$
\Psi_i = [\psi(i,1), \dots, \psi(i,n)]^T \qquad n=|\mathcal N|.
$$

Both the full vector and its restriction to the [neighborhood](#def-neighborhood), written $\Psi_{i,\mathcal N_i}$, are used. The restriction, which drops exactly the zero entries, is what [positional invariance](#def-positional-invariance) compares across nodes; the full vector is what the identification formulas pass to an exposure mapping once that assumption lets a single function serve every unit.
:::
